title: Rav Idi son of Rav Ika
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Yevamot 43a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.43a.5), where Rav Huna bar Manoach speaks in his name; and in [Gittin 84b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.84b.5) Rav Ada son of Rav Ika is mentioned.[^1]

notes.text: In Yevamot, Rav Huna bar Manoach speaks in the name of Rav Idi son of Rav Ika. Gittin gives Rav Ada son of Rav Ika.
